project_type: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.x + Pydantic v2 backend (Python), with an offline ml/ training workspace (torch/transformers/sklearn) producing small runtime artifacts copied into backend/app/ml/artifacts/. Mobile/web frontend exists but is untouched by this task.
build_system: pip + requirements.txt (no build step). Runtime path is torch-free for recommendations (sklearn+numpy only). pytest with no pytest.ini/pyproject (default discovery). Tests run from backend/ with `python -m pytest tests -q`. Windows/PowerShell: use ';' not '&&' to chain commands; script paths use backslashes (e.g. python notebooks\10_ranking_model.py).
test_framework: pytest, SQLite in-memory via create_engine("sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool) + Base.metadata.create_all (see tests/test_purchase_history_route.py). Live/Postgres tests (test_live_integration.py) self-skip without Postgres.
build_command: cd backend ; python -c "import app.main" (smoke import). No compile step.
verification_instructions: 1) cd backend ; python -m pytest tests -q — full suite must pass (existing tests green + new tests green). 2) Targeted: cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_<module>.py -q for fast feedback on a single module. 3) The ml notebook (ml/notebooks/10_ranking_model.py) requires the ml/ env (torch/transformers) + downloaded Polyvore dataset; running it is OPTIONAL for shipping — if it passes the ship-gate (AUC >= baseline + 0.02) it copies artifacts to backend/app/ml/artifacts/, otherwise artifacts stay absent and the runtime uses the heuristic fallback (no test depends on the artifact being present). Baseline verified: 17 existing tests in test_recommendation_agent.py + test_context_agent.py + test_llm_agent.py + test_compatibility_model.py pass (sklearn 1.9.1 runtime; joblib artifacts pickled in 1.5.0 emit InconsistentVersionWarning, non-blocking).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Optional runtime artifacts produced ONLY by the training notebook if ship-gate passes: backend/app/ml/artifacts/ranking_model.joblib (~KB) and backend/app/ml/artifacts/context_vectors.npz (~197KB: 96 vectors x 512 x 4 bytes). Command to produce: cd ml ; python notebooks\10_ranking_model.py. If the ship-gate fails or ml env/data is unavailable, do NOT commit these files — the runtime falls back to the exact existing heuristic. ml/data/processed/ intermediates are gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell shell: chain with ';' not '&&'. get_settings() is @lru_cache (app/core/config.py) — overriding flags in tests requires monkeypatch.setenv(...) + get_settings.cache_clear() (patching app.core.config.get_settings does NOT propagate because modules bind the name at import). Never restart a dev server. The recommendation path must stay torch-free at runtime (only sklearn/numpy loaded); torch is installed only for the Vision Agent and offline training. .agents/ is NOT gitignored but holds task metadata (design docs already committed there); FEAT json files are task metadata, not feature code to commit.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering present. Enrich, do not rewrite: the RecommendationAgent already works — extend it with optional backward-compatible kwargs. Reuse existing infra (vector_store, LLMAgent, ContextAgent, compatibility_model, catalog_index) — extend, don't fork. Graceful fallback at every layer: LLM=none -> rules+template; Pinecone off -> existing behavior (fetch_embeddings returns {}); artifacts absent -> exact heuristic fallback. Keep existing tests green (the new conftest forces flags False by default so existing tests run the fallback path). Commit per feature on the branch; never push.
key_patterns: Agent pattern: classes extend BaseAgent (app/agents/base.py) with run(**kwargs)->dict. ML artifact loader pattern: MODEL_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'artifacts'/X.joblib, @lru_cache on _load_model, fallback when artifact absent (see app/ml/compatibility_model.py — mirror it exactly in ranking_model.py). LLM guard: `if self.settings.llm_provider == 'none': return None` at the TOP of every LLM method before any httpx.post (see llm_agent.run). Orchestrator closure `generate` is called up to 2x — compute context-dependent inputs (references, ctx_vec) ONCE before the closure. ContextAgent returns a plain dict absorbed by OutfitRecommendationResult.context: dict (untyped). Tests use _FakeItem (no `season` attribute) — use getattr(item,'season',None) to avoid AttributeError. SQLite test fixture pattern in test_purchase_history_route.py (StaticPool + Base.metadata.create_all + app.dependency_overrides).
